dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Continuous and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section to a sharp posterior point.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to white mature skin tone; high median pixel intensity across the dorsal plane with minimal visible pigment.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp contrast gradient along the longitudinal dorsal ridge where high-reflectance skin meets shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast dark circular blowhole aperture and a prominent, elongated dorsal ridge.
